candidates.purpose: Establish a baseline fit with no features to compare against regularized models.
candidates.expected_effect: Hypothesis: provides a reference level of fit quality against which ridge variants may show improvement or degradation.

candidates.purpose: Low-regularization ridge fit on a coarse feature grid at half fidelity.
candidates.expected_effect: Hypothesis: weak regularization with coarse features may capture broad structure while limiting overfitting.

candidates.purpose: Moderate-regularization ridge fit on a coarse feature grid at half fidelity.
candidates.expected_effect: Hypothesis: moderate regularization may balance bias and variance on the coarse grid.

candidates.purpose: Strong-regularization ridge fit on a coarse feature grid at half fidelity.
candidates.expected_effect: Hypothesis: strong regularization may reduce variance at the cost of underfitting coarse features.

candidates.purpose: Low-regularization ridge fit on a finer feature grid at half fidelity.

candidates.purpose: Moderate-regularization ridge fit on a finer feature grid at half fidelity.

candidates.purpose: Strong-regularization ridge fit on a finer feature grid at half fidelity.
candidates.expected_effect: Hypothesis: strong regularization may stabilize the finer feature expansion.

candidates.purpose: Low-regularization ridge fit on a coarse feature grid at full fidelity.

candidates.purpose: Strong-regularization ridge fit on a coarse feature grid at full fidelity.

candidates.purpose: Low-regularization ridge fit on a finer feature grid at full fidelity.

candidates.purpose: Moderate-regularization ridge fit on a finer feature grid at full fidelity.
